content.user_title: Run Parallel Research With Multiple Agents
content.value_statement: Large research tasks can take too long when one agent works alone. This skill helps coordinate parallel research agents and synthesize findings from multiple lines of inquiry.
actual_capabilities: Describes a workflow for using ten agents on parallel research tasks.
Identifies broad research tasks that benefit from multiple lines of inquiry.
Points users to the upstream repository for installation and detailed usage.
Encourages validation, testing, and expert review before relying on results.
Instructs users to ask for clarification when inputs or permissions are unclear.
limitations: The package contains only SKILL.md and no local implementation files.
Installation and detailed usage instructions are hosted in an external repository.
Research outputs still require independent validation and expert review.
Narrow questions may not need a multi-agent research process.

use_cases.title: Compare Market Signals
use_cases.description: Split research across competitors, customer segments, pricing signals, and recent news before producing a combined brief.

use_cases.title: Investigate Technical Options
use_cases.description: Assign separate agents to libraries, architecture risks, migration paths, and production constraints before choosing a direction.

use_cases.title: Build Policy Briefs
use_cases.description: Run parallel research on stakeholders, regulations, evidence quality, and open questions before drafting a decision memo.

prompt_templates.title: Start Broad Research
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Infinite Gratitude for parallel research on this topic: [topic]. Summarize key findings, sources to verify, and open questions.

prompt_templates.title: Split Research Areas
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the multi-agent research workflow for [topic]. Divide the work into ten research areas and synthesize the strongest evidence.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Competing Options
prompt_templates.prompt: Research these options in parallel: [options]. Compare benefits, risks, evidence quality, and conditions where each option is best.

prompt_templates.title: Produce Decision Brief
prompt_templates.prompt: Run a parallel research review for [decision]. Return a concise brief with assumptions, evidence gaps, risks, and recommended next steps.

output_examples.input: Research whether our team should adopt a new observability platform.
output_examples.output: A structured brief covering vendors, migration risk, cost drivers, team impact, evidence gaps, and a recommended shortlist.

output_examples.input: Investigate market demand for a compliance automation product.
output_examples.output: A research synthesis that compares buyer segments, regulations, competitors, adoption barriers, and questions for customer interviews.

output_examples.input: Evaluate three deployment strategies for a legacy application.
output_examples.output: A decision memo that separates architecture findings, operational risks, testing needs, and recommended sequencing.

best_practices: Use the skill for broad questions that can be split into independent research tracks.
Provide clear success criteria, allowed sources, time limits, and required output format.
Review source quality and verify important claims before acting on the synthesis.
anti_patterns: Do not use this workflow for simple factual lookups that need one direct answer.
Do not treat generated research as a substitute for expert review or testing.
Do not clone or install external code without reviewing the exact commit and permissions.

faq.question: What does this skill help with?
faq.answer: It helps coordinate parallel research across multiple agents and combine findings into a useful synthesis.

faq.question: Does this package include the full implementation?
faq.answer: No. The reviewed package contains SKILL.md and points to an external repository for installation and usage details.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: When should I use it?
faq.answer: Use it when a topic has many independent research areas that can be investigated in parallel.

faq.question: What should I provide in my prompt?
faq.answer: Provide the research topic, success criteria, source boundaries, time limits, and desired final format.

faq.question: What is the main security consideration?
faq.answer: The skill directs users to an external repository, so review the exact source before cloning or installing it.
